label: Events
purpose: One landing page per webinar, workshop, class or live event
roleNote: search = built to rank and be quoted by AI: passes the keyword gate, full SEO/AEO/GEO. resource = reached from content, social posts or email: shows exactly what the visitor gets, no keyword gate, lighter word count, preview required. both = a resource that also passed the keyword gate.

goal.note: Pages that share a goal share one success page. {slug} gives each page its own.

title.help: Main keyword first, then the business name

description.help: What the page offers, one proof point, the action

h1.help: The visitor's problem or outcome, with the main keyword

keyword.help: Only if role is search or both

subtext.help: Two lines max: who it is for + the strongest proof

goal.help: The one conversion goal id. Used in data-cta and names the success page

cta.help: Button text that says what they get

success.help: The success page this goal ends on (usually the same as goal)

socialHook.help: The phrase social posts use to send people here (for example: comment GUIDE)

startsAt.help: ISO date and time with timezone

preview.help: What they get, shown on the page: an image of the resource, a sample excerpt, or the agenda
